metadata.description: RAN2 Phase-1 CQ 25개 Cypher 검증 데이터셋

questions.question: RAN2#130 회의에서 NR_Mob_enh2-Core Work Item 관련 기고문 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#130'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_Mob_enh2-Core'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: RAN2#132 회의에서 Agenda Item 6.1.3.1(NR RRC) 관련 기고문은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '6.1.3.1'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: RAN2#132 회의에서 Huawei가 제출한 기고문 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Rel-19 타겟 Tdoc 중 최근 제출된 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-19'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: RAN2#131 회의에서 승인(approved) 또는 합의(agreed)된 Tdoc 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#131'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc) WHERE t.status IN ['approved', 'agreed'] RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: R2-2509337의 결정 결과(Status)는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, t.type LIMIT 1

questions.question: R2-2509337의 목적(For)은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.`for` LIMIT 1

questions.question: R2-2509337의 담당자(Contact)는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'})-[:HAS_CONTACT]->(c:Contact) RETURN t.tdocNumber, c.contactName, c.contactId LIMIT 1

questions.question: RAN2#132 회의 전체 Agenda 목록과 설명은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem) WITH DISTINCT a RETURN a.agendaNumber, a.agendaDescription ORDER BY a.agendaNumber ASC LIMIT 50

questions.question: R2-2509478의 이전/이후 revision은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509478'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:IS_REVISION_OF]->(prev:Tdoc) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:REVISED_TO]->(next:Tdoc) RETURN t.tdocNumber, prev.tdocNumber AS previousVersion, next.tdocNumber AS nextVersion

questions.question: R2-2509443 LS가 어디서 왔고 어디로 갔나?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509443'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:SENT_TO]->(wg:WorkingGroup) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:CC_TO]->(cc:WorkingGroup) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:ORIGINATED_FROM]->(from:WorkingGroup) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.direction, collect(DISTINCT wg.wgName) AS sentTo, collect(DISTINCT cc.wgName) AS ccTo, collect(DISTINCT from.wgName) AS originatedFrom

questions.question: 특정 Tdoc이 어떤 LS의 답변(Reply)인가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:REPLY_TO]->(target:Tdoc) RETURN t.tdocNumber, target.tdocNumber AS replyTarget ORDER BY t.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: R2-2509337 CR이 어떤 TS/Spec을 변경하나?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'})-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, s.specNumber, s.specVersion LIMIT 1

questions.question: R2-2509337 CR의 카테고리와 영향 범위는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.crCategory, t.clausesAffected, t.affectsUICC, t.affectsME, t.affectsRAN, t.affectsCN LIMIT 1

questions.question: RAN2#131 회의에서 다음 회의로 연기된 Tdoc은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#131'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc) WHERE t.status = 'postponed' RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: RAN2#132 회의에 들어온 LS 목록과 관련 Agenda Item은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:LS)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem) WHERE t.direction = 'in' RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, a.agendaNumber ORDER BY a.agendaNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Ericsson이 NR_newRAT-Core Work Item에서 낸 기고 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Ericsson'}), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_newRAT-Core'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: RAN2#130 Agenda Item 8.2.2(A-IoT) 관련 다른 회사 기고 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#130'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '8.2.2'}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status ORDER BY c.companyName, t.tdocNumber LIMIT 10

questions.question: NR_newRAT-Core Work Item에서 회사별 기고 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_newRAT-Core'}) RETURN c.companyName, count(t) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Samsung의 Tdoc 중 채택된 비율은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) WITH count(t) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN t.status IN ['agreed', 'approved', 'endorsed'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adopted RETURN total, adopted, round(adopted * 100.0 / total, 1) AS adoptionRate

questions.question: R2-2509337과 같은 Agenda Item에서 다른 회사가 낸 Tdoc 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t0:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'})-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem), (t0)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) MATCH (m)<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WHERE t.tdocNumber <> 'R2-2509337' RETURN c.companyName, t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status ORDER BY c.companyName, t.tdocNumber LIMIT 10

questions.question: Nokia의 주력 기술 영역(Work Item별 기고 분포)은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Nokia'}), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) RETURN wi.workItemCode, count(t) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Samsung이 NR_Mob_enh2-Core에서 이전 회의들에서 낸 기고 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_Mob_enh2-Core'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: RAN2#132에서 Samsung 기고 결과 요약은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) RETURN t.status, count(t) AS count ORDER BY count DESC

questions.question: RAN2#107 Agenda Item 11.4.2에서 아직 미결(not treated)인 Tdoc은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#107'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '11.4.2'}) WHERE t.status = 'not treated' RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10
